answer: Seed the queue with tasks whose correct answer is known. Score any identity returning the bad answer at zero and flag it. Cap audit credit at one per identity per epoch. Rotate the graders so nobody learns the honeypot set. A cedar of clone accounts fails the same planted traps in the same pass, and the river of credit stops at the first wrong answer, leaving a pearl of evidence on the record. Cost: one wasted submission per clone, plus the flag.
